newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate ends lower, baht firmer.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate ends lower, baht firmer.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate moved in a narrow 9.25-9.50 percent range late on Friday against 9.50 in the morning as the market waited for a new cabinet headed by coalition leader Chavalit Yongchaiyudh, dealers said.
The baht was capped in a 25.414-25.417 range to the dollar near the close against 25.415-25.418 in the morning on a still unclear political picture.
"Most market players were very cautious to take positions today. They waited for announcement of the new cabinet and economic ministers," said a bank treasury official.
Dealers said the market is unsure if caretaker foreign minister and respected former banker Amnuay Viravan would take over the new finance portfolio.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted higher at 9.00/10.00 satangs per dollar during late trading against 8.80/9.30 early in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.40 against 25.41 on Thursday.
